milestone: Synchronous native CPU immutable scalar-field records

implementation.syntax: Named indented type declarations; Type { field: value } construction; record.field access; record with { field: value } derivation
implementation.identity: Nominal module-local record table indices in typed values; imported function results preserve their declaring record identity
implementation.evaluation: Update base first; field initializers/replacements evaluated once in written order; omitted fields retain original value
implementation.lowering: MLIR LLVM literal structs, insertvalue and extractvalue; no managed heap allocation for scalar-field records; existing checked invocation ABI handles failures

contract.functions: Synchronous helper parameters/results, explicit/inferred returns, recursion and conditionals
contract.collections: Records inside synchronous numeric map callbacks and numeric fields used as tensor inputs; record elements/record captures are not enabled
contract.modules: Inferred imported record values retain nominal identity; type names remain private
contract.gates: Record-containing graphs reject task/error continuations and GPU placement. Main cannot display records directly. Nested records/collection fields/type exports remain unsupported. Internal layout is not public C/C++ or wire ABI.

scope: Debug and ASan/UBSan frontend checks cover field types, immutable construction/read/update, helpers/branches/maps, nominal same-spelling module identity, forward declarations, name collisions and unsupported syntax/type/execution gates
Twelve malformed typed-IR mutations rejected before native lowering, plus explicit GPU and continuation planner gates

Generated programs cover all six numeric layouts plus Bool, mixed records with integer endpoints, signed floating zero, float64 precision, unchanged originals, recursive record helpers, conditional records, inline/named maps and tensor shape operands
Imported helper records preserve declaration identity across a multi-file call graph; same-layout records from distinct declarations are rejected

Written field/replacement order differing from declaration order, base-before-update order and checked arithmetic failure tested using distinguishable Bounds/Arithmetic faults; unselected faulting branch stays unevaluated
Unsupported direct record display fails without replacing executable/LLVM/MLIR output artifacts

Existing numeric/collection/control/module frontend suites, retained collection display/worker results, representative map/index/query runtime checks, CPU task/recovery/storage/continuation suites and selected Metal regressions; focused qualification, not full-suite coverage

remaining_gates: Record worker captures/results and continuation storage
Nested records and collection fields with ownership qualification
Record type exports and broader module/package composition
Record CLI display and richer values/variants
Record GPU integration and public native library ABI
